findings.evidence: the "invite-sent" section defines 0 controls whose target names another defined state (1 incoming link from elsewhere in the artifact).
findings.fix: Add a control inside the "invite-sent" section whose target is another state the artifact defines, for example a back, cancel, or continue control.
findings.violation: This state offers no control whose target names another state the artifact defines, so a user who reaches it has no path to leave it within the artifact.

findings.evidence: project-settings section: the "Save" button for project name has no target state specified; artifact defines no next screen or loading state. notification-settings section: the "Save" button has no form action and its target section ID in the href points to itself.
findings.fix: For the project name form, specify a success screen showing the save completed, or add a "Saving..." to "Saved" status indication. For notification settings, specify a distinct confirmation screen, or show a transient success message in place before returning to settings.
findings.location: project-settings section (project name save), notification-settings section (digest frequency save)
findings.violation: The artifact specifies no visible indication of whether these save actions succeeded, completed, or failed, so the user cannot tell whether their action committed.

findings.evidence: <button> with no text content and no accessible-name attribute
findings.fix: Add visible text to this control, or an aria-label attribute naming what it does.
findings.violation: This control has neither visible text nor an accessible-name attribute, so nothing on screen names what the control does.

findings.evidence: archive-confirm shows "Archive this project?" with explanation that the user can "restore it at any time from the archived projects list". The artifact then shows a project-archived state confirming the archive completed. However, the artifact contains no "archived projects list" screen and no restore control anywhere.
findings.fix: Either add a screen showing the archived projects list with a restore control, or remove the promise that restoration is available "at any time" from the confirmation text.
findings.location: archive-confirm section (the confirmation text), and globally (no restore control defined)
findings.violation: The artifact claims archiving is reversible and restoration is available, but defines no path in the interface to restore an archived project, leaving a user with no way to follow through on that promise.
